contracts.description: Documents as Canonical Markdown with opaque version tokens: list, read, create (1.2) and base-versioned revise by the local Installation Person or a locally bound Workspace Agent (1.1), live change invalidation, and runtime guidance (1.2).

ports.name: runtime.guide
ports.description: Read bounded guidance for listing and reading Documents, creating then revising, base versions and merges, Host-derived authorship, errors and uncertain outcomes (1.2).

ports.name: document.list
ports.description: List Collections and Documents in Order Key order, at most 64 per page; pass next as after for the following page. With collectionId, only that Collection's Documents. version is present only for an available body. Errors: documents.unknown_collection, documents.invalid_cursor.

ports.name: document.markdown
ports.description: Read a Document body as Canonical Markdown with the version token it was exported at. Errors: documents.pending (records not yet opened; retry later), documents.unavailable (conflicted, failed import, or a version the token cannot carry), documents.too_large (the response exceeds the Host Port value bound, MAX_UI_PAYLOAD_BYTES), documents.unknown_document.

ports.name: document.create
ports.description: Create an empty Document in a Collection as one record signed by the local Person or the caller's bound Agent (1.2). Returns documentId and version; pass version as baseVersion to document.revise to add content. Errors: documents.unknown_collection, documents.collection_archived, documents.invalid_title, documents.actor_unauthorized, documents.principal_not_bound. Every accepted create makes a new Document: an uncertain command must not be retried automatically; list and reconcile first.

ports.name: document.revise
ports.description: Merge Markdown revised from the baseVersion export as one record signed by the local Person or (1.1) the caller's bound Agent; changed false appends nothing. Errors: documents.base_unavailable, documents.revision_too_large, documents.schema_violation, documents.unknown_document, documents.pending, documents.unavailable, documents.actor_unauthorized, documents.principal_not_bound. version may include concurrent edits; read again before revising. An uncertain command must not be retried automatically.

ports.name: documents.changed
ports.description: Live-only, at-most-once invalidation that may coalesce; no initial event or replay. documentIds names Documents whose body changed; without it, re-list. Re-query on receipt or reconnection.
